title: Discovering Bias in Latent Space: An Unsupervised Debiasing Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy variance and standard deviation across different permutations of answer options, such as swapping 'yes/no' to 'no/yes' prompts or using an answer-moving attack to place the correct answer in different positions (e.g., A, B, C) for multiple-choice questions.
